fixture.legacy.stats.description: A small, worn-handled carving knife the Tensor Sect entrusted to Ganji as a gift, in recognition of how important he was to them. Its blade never dulls and can shave stone as easily as wood.
fixture.legacy.stats.enchantment: Never needs sharpening; can carve or shave solid stone as if it were wood.
fixture.legacy.stats.origin: A gift from the Tensor Sect itself, given to Ganji for his importance to them. Its enchantment is unexplained -- the Sect never told him where its magic came from, and its make matches nothing in their records.
